zh.text: 修复玩家「只有游戏声音、没有游戏窗口」：补回 Play.bat 的显示安全步骤，并在配置中心新增「修复游戏窗口」按钮，一键把客户端窗口重置到当前主屏 · 窗口模式 · 左上角
客户端配置新增「强制安全窗口模式」开关，写回 EvEJSConfig.bat 的 EVEJS_CLIENT_SAFE_WINDOWED，开启后每次启动都会重置窗口位置与分辨率
修复 0.1.16 引入的「游戏进程在跑、有声音、但完全没有游戏窗口」：启动客户端时移除了 windowsHide（它会让 Windows 把游戏窗口创建成隐藏状态）
模组管理新增 mods 目录检测：缺失时给出说明并提供「创建 mods 文件夹」按钮
修复字体发虚看不清：移除被墙的 Google Fonts 外链、改用系统字体栈，并提高底栏字号与文字对比度
底栏 EVEJS 版本号改为读取服务端真实版本（config/version.json），不再显示写死的旧版本
修复底栏在线人数不刷新：启动器此前只采集一次资源指标，现改为每 5 秒刷新，并按游戏端口统计已连接客户端数
模组管理接入官方 manifest schema 3（M1）：扫描 mods 目录与 evejs-launcher.mod.json、校验清单、列表真实模组、一键启停 loader（改名 loader.js.disabled ↔ loader.js），并在启动主服务时通过 NODE_OPTIONS=--require 注入，服务端文件零改动；同时清理了原有演示卡片与演示弹窗
新增《EveJS 模组制作规范》文档：启动器每次启动自动释放到 _launcher\mods\MOD_AUTHORING.md，并在模组管理页提供「模组制作规范」按钮一键查看；文档涵盖 manifest schema 3 字段、loader 注入原理、NODE_OPTIONS 路径规则、内存与加载顺序规范、可用的服务端接口、会话属性与上线宽限期两个坑、完整代码骨架与排错清单

en.text: Fixed the "game sound but no game window" issue for players: restored the display-safety step from Play.bat and added a "Repair game window" button in the config center that resets the client to windowed mode at the top-left of the primary screen
Added a "Force safe windowed mode" switch to the client config that writes EVEJS_CLIENT_SAFE_WINDOWED into EvEJSConfig.bat; when enabled the window position and resolution are reset on every launch
Fixed the "game process runs with sound but no game window" regression introduced in 0.1.16 by removing windowsHide when spawning the client (it made Windows create the game window in a hidden state)
Mod management now detects the mods folder and shows an explanation plus a "Create mods folder" button when it is missing
Fixed blurry, hard-to-read fonts: removed the blocked Google Fonts request, switched to system font stacks, and increased the status bar font size and text contrast
The EVEJS version in the status bar now reads the real server version from config/version.json instead of a hard-coded stale value
Fixed the online player count never updating: the launcher only sampled metrics once, it now refreshes every 5 seconds and counts connected clients on the game port

Mod management now supports the official manifest schema 3 (M1): scans the mods folder and evejs-launcher.mod.json, validates manifests, lists real mods, toggles loaders (renaming loader.js.disabled <-> loader.js) and injects them into the game server via NODE_OPTIONS=--require with zero server-file changes; the old demo cards and demo dialogs were removed

Added the EveJS Mod Authoring Guide: the launcher now releases it to _launcher\mods\MOD_AUTHORING.md on every start and provides a "Mod authoring guide" button in the Mods page; the guide covers manifest schema 3 fields, how loader injection works, NODE_OPTIONS path rules, memory and load-order guidance, available server APIs, the session-property and login-grace pitfalls, a full code skeleton and a troubleshooting checklist
